types.name: Incident
types.description: A production incident or outage with a unique identifier, impact assessment, and resolution

types.name: Runbook
types.description: A documented procedure for diagnosing and resolving operational issues

types.name: CitationTag
types.description: A stable identifier assigned to retrieved chunks for citation purposes (e.g., T1, E1, M1)

types.name: PipelineStage
types.description: A named phase in a multi-stage data processing pipeline

types.name: GoldenSet
types.description: A curated fixed set of questions with reference answers used for regression testing

types.name: EvaluationVersion
types.description: A specific version or release of a system being evaluated

types.name: PermissionGroup
types.description: A security group or role used for access control to content

types.name: VectorCollection
types.description: A named collection of vector embeddings in a vector database
